title: Didn't descale Keurig
text:
Didn't descale Keurig. Got the Descaler Pro Kit today and used it in accordance with instructions.
It didn't work.

Bought it because coffee maker only produced 7 ounces of liquid on setting that was for 9.25 ounces. After descaling the Keurig it only produced 7.5 ounces of liquid. So, the XROM kit was of no value whatsoever.

Will never buy this kit again!!!
